pairs: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
Quid est quod inter vos parabolam vertitis in proverbium istud in terra Israël, dicentes:
“Why is it that you circulate among yourselves this parable, as a proverb in the land of Israel,
saying: ‘The fathers ate a bitter grape,
and the teeth of the sons have been affected.’
si erit ultra vobis parabola hæc in proverbium in Israël.
this parable shall no longer be a proverb for you in Israel.
Just as the soul of the father is mine,
so also is the soul of the son.
And if a man is just,
and he accomplishes judgment and justice,
and if he does not eat upon the mountains,
et oculos suos non levaverit ad idola domus Israël:
nor lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel,
et uxorem proximi sui non violaverit,
and if he has not violated the wife of his neighbor,
et ad mulierem menstruatam non accesserit:
and if he has not grieved any man,
but has restored the collateral to the debtor,
if he has seized nothing by violence,
has given his bread to the hungry,
and has covered the naked with a garment,
if he has not lent upon usury,
if he has averted his hand from iniquity,
et judicium verum fecerit inter virum et virum:
and has executed true judgment between man and man,
if he has walked in my precepts
so that he acts in accord with truth,
But if he raises a son who is a robber,
and who does any of these things,
et hæc quidem omnia non facientem,
(even though he himself does not do any of these things,)
and who eats upon the mountains,
and who defiles the wife of his neighbor,
who grieves the needy and the poor,
who does not restore the collateral,
et ad idola levantem oculos suos,
and who lifts up his eyes to idols,
Since he has done all these detestable things,
His blood shall be upon him.
But if he raises a son,
qui videns omnia peccata patris sui quæ fecit,
seeing all his father’s sins that he has done,
is afraid and so does not act in a way similar to him,
who does not eat upon the mountains,
et oculos suos non levaverit ad idola domus Israël,
nor lift up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel,
et uxorem proximi sui non violaverit:
and who does not violate the wife of his neighbor,
and who has not grieved any man,
but instead has given his bread to the hungry,
and has covered the naked with a garment,
a pauperis injuria averterit manum suam,
who has averted his hand from injuring the poor,
who has not taken usury and an overabundance,
who has acted according to my judgments and walked in my precepts,
then this one shall not die for the iniquity of his father;
hic non morietur in iniquitate patris sui,
because he oppressed and did violence to his brother,
and worked evil in the midst of his people,
et malum operatus est in medio populi sui,
ecce mortuus est in iniquitate sua.
he has died by his own iniquity.
Quare non portavit filius iniquitatem patris?
‘Why has not the son borne the iniquity of the father?’
since the son has worked judgment and justice,
The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father,
et pater non portabit iniquitatem filii:
and the father shall not bear the iniquity of the son.
The justice of the just man shall be upon himself,
et impietas impii erit super eum.
but the impiety of the impious man shall be upon himself.
Si autem impius egerit pœnitentiam ab omnibus peccatis suis quæ operatus est,
But if the impious man does penance for all his sins which he has committed,
and if he keeps all my precepts,
Omnium iniquitatum ejus quas operatus est,
I will not remember all his iniquities, which he has worked;
in justitia sua quam operatus est, vivet.
which he has worked, he shall live.
Numquid voluntatis meæ est mors impii,
How could it be my will that an impious man should die,
et non ut convertatur a viis suis,
and not that he should be converted from his ways
Si autem averterit se justus a justitia sua,
But if a just man turns himself away from his justice,
et fecerit iniquitatem secundum omnes abominationes quas operari solet impius,
and does iniquity in accord with all the abominations that the impious man so often does,
All his justices, which he has accomplished,
By the transgression, in which he has transgressed,
et in peccato suo quod peccavit,
and by his sin, in which he has sinned,
‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’
numquid via mea non est æqua,
How could it be that my way is not fair?
et non magis viæ vestræ pravæ sunt?
And is it not instead your ways that are perverse?
Cum enim averterit se justus a justitia sua,
For when the just man turns himself away from his justice,
in injustitia quam operatus est morietur.
by the injustice that he has worked, he shall die.
Et cum averterit se impius ab impietate sua quam operatus est,
And when the impious man turns himself away from his impiety,
he shall cause his own soul to live.
For by considering and turning himself away from all his iniquities,
et avertens se ab omnibus iniquitatibus suis quas operatus est,
And yet the sons of Israel say,
‘The way of the Lord is not fair.’
Numquid viæ meæ non sunt æquæ,
How could it be that my ways are not fair,
et non magis viæ vestræ pravæ?
And is it not instead your ways that are perverse?
Idcirco unumquemque juxta vias suas judicabo,
I will judge each one according to his ways,
et agite pœnitentiam ab omnibus iniquitatibus vestris,
Be converted, and do penance for all your iniquities,
et non erit vobis in ruinam iniquitas.
and then iniquity will not be your ruin.
Projicite a vobis omnes prævaricationes vestras in quibus prævaricati estis,
Cast all your transgressions, by which you have transgressed, away from you,
et facite vobis cor novum, et spiritum novum:
and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit.
And then why should you die,
For I do not desire the death of one who dies,
